dependencies.evidence: Non-read requests were blocked during archive creation and local execution. The local flow passed after dismissing the supported No Thanks UI overlay.

No page worker event was observed during the instrumented online seed; this is not a proof that the full site never uses workers.
No .wasm URL or application/wasm response was observed; embedded or dynamically constructed WASM was not excluded.
The observed calculation values exist in a render-time closure. No supported module export accepting build JSON and returning Character Stats was identified.
